request: Add OAuth login with callback handling, session persistence, account UI changes and integration tests.
Add a CSV export button to the reports page that downloads the currently filtered rows.
Fix the date formatting bug in the invoice table where UTC dates render as the previous day for Pacific users.
The retry queue double-processes jobs when the worker restarts mid-batch; find and fix the cause.
Update the README installation instructions for Windows PowerShell.
Write a CONTRIBUTING guide describing the branch naming and PR review process we use.
Replace the hard-coded admin role check with permission-based authorization across API routes.
Rotate the JWT signing key and add key-id support so old tokens keep validating during the rollover window.
Extract the pricing calculations from the checkout controller into a pure module without changing behavior.
Rename the internal helper formatMoney to formatCurrency everywhere it is used.
Migrate the users table from a single name column to first_name and last_name, with a backfill and a rollback migration.
Upgrade the project from Express 4 to Express 5 and fix any breaking middleware changes.
Add unit tests for the slugify helper covering unicode, repeated dashes and empty input.
Add a GitHub Actions workflow that runs lint and tests on pull requests using Node 22.
Explain why the dashboard page takes eight seconds to load on the staging environment; do not change anything yet.
Change the button label on the settings page from Save to Save changes.
